compiled_state.title: As a reconciler operator, I want outbound status pushes to consult local_to_jira_status and fall back to a Jira comment on workflow-illegal transitions
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: local_to_jira_status config table + outbound_update status-mapping path. Missing entry raises StatusMappingError. 400 illegal-transition triggers Jira-comment fallback instead of retry.
**Why**: Status-mapping is the most common cause of 400 retry storms in bidirectional bridges; this makes the fallback explicit and observable.
**Scope**:
- IN: local_to_jira_status config table, applier outbound_update status routing, StatusMappingError (fail-loud), comment-fallback on 400 illegal-transition
- OUT: Status normalization across multiple Jira workflows (single-project DIG only), retry logic for legitimate failures

## Done Definitions

- An (outbound, update) mutation with a status delta whose target is missing from local_to_jira_status causes the orchestrator to raise StatusMappingError and exit non-zero before any applier leaf runs ← Satisfies: sc-5
- Against a Jira issue in a status from which Done is workflow-illegal, the next pass emits a Jira comment containing the substring 'local status changed to ' and the applier records zero update_issue HTTP 400 retries ← Satisfies: sc-5
- The config table is consulted by the applier (not the differ) so that the differ remains pure; a test asserts no import path from differ.py to the status config module ← Satisfies: sc-2, sc-5
- Unit tests written and passing for all new logic ← Validates Closure Check: "TDD DoD"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] StatusMappingError is intentionally fail-loud — do not soften to a warning; partial passes with silent status drops are the failure mode the abort protects against.
- [Observability] The Jira comment text format 'local status changed to <X>' is part of the SC contract; do not paraphrase.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body: Story closure: P1=PASS 4/4 DDs. preflight_status_mapping raises StatusMappingError before applier dispatch; comment-fallback on 400 illegal-transition (zero retries, 'local status changed to' substring, structured JSON log); differ purity AST + string-literal tests confirm differ has no local_to_jira_status coupling; 20/20 prior-task tests GREEN. INC-010 documented.
